mapper.sql: id, device_id, employee_id, session_token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, ended_at, end_reason
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.device_id, s.employee_id, e.actual_name AS employee_name, s.issued_at, s.expires_at, s.ended_at, s.end_reason, (s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS active FROM xsy_scale_device_session s LEFT JOIN t_employee e ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id WHERE s.device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY s.issued_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
